newsitem.title: USA: CarrAmerica in $200 mln debt offering.
newsitem.headline: CarrAmerica in $200 mln debt offering.

text.p: CarrAmerica Realty Corp said on Monday that it would make a private offering of $200 million principal amount of long-term debt to fund acquisition and development activities.
The offering will be comprised of $75 million aggregate principal amount of notes due 2004 and $125 million aggregate principal amount of notes due 2007, the company said in a statement.

In addition, the real estate investment trust said it intends to make an offering of its series B cumulative redeemable preferred stock. That offering will be made by means of a prospectus to be filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission, CarrAmerica said.
